names.zh: 毒液穿甲炮

en.description: Rapid-fire toxin cannon: damages enemy vessels with a toxic sludge that can penetrate hulls and cause crews to become confused, turning on their allies.
en.name: Carcinnox

zh.description: 速射毒素炮：发射毒素粘液来损坏敌方舰船，这种粘液能穿透船体，让敌方船员陷入混乱、自相残杀。
zh.name: 毒液穿甲炮

names.zh: 急冻粒子炮

en.description: Ice wave generator: slams enemy ships with waves of frozen particulate freezing enemy propulsion systems and slowing them to a standstill.
en.name: Cryophon

zh.description: 冰浪发生器：通过发射冰冷微粒所形成的波浪来打击敌舰，这种攻击能冻结敌舰的推进系统，使其动弹不得。
zh.name: 急冻粒子炮
